subject: general
question: Who wrote the famous book 'Ignited Minds'?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **A.P.J. Abdul Kalam**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ignited Minds**: Unleashing the Power Within India is a book written by** A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, President of India from 2002 to 2007**. 
 
• The book is a logical step forward from Dr. Kalam's earlier book, India 2020.
 
• A Vision for the New Millennium and consists of many inspirational messages by A P J Abdul Kalam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Robin Sharma is a Canadian writer, **best known for his **The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari book** series. Sharma worked as a litigation lawyer until age 25, when he self-published MegaLiving, a book on stress management and spirituality.
 
• Nilanjana Sudeshna "**Jhumpa" Lahiri** is an American author known for her short stories, novels and essays in English, and, more recently, in Italia

 
• **Chetan Baghat, **a rising star in the contemporary modern Indian literature, is a multitalented personality. He is a novelist, columnist, public speaker and a screenplay writer. **His notable works include Five Point Someone, The 3 Mistakes of My Life and 2 States**.
